# Pygame

In these last two parts of this course material we will get to grips with the pygame library. It is a Python library for programming games. It helps you create graphical elements, handle events from the keyboard and the mouse, and implement other features necessary in games.

## Installing pygame

### Linux

Open a command line, type in `pip3 install pygame` an press `enter`.

![Linux installation](/images/pygame_linux.png)

This should install the pygame library on your computer.

### Windows

Open the Windows terminal by opening the menu, typing in `cmd` and pressing `enter`:

![Windows cmd](/images/13_1_1.png)

The command line interpreter window should open. Type in `pip3 install pygame` and press `enter`.

This should install the pygame library on your computer.

### Mac

Open the _Terminal_, for example through the magnifying glass symbol in the top right corner:

![Mac spotlight](/images/13-1-2.png)

The search tool should open. Type in `terminal` and press `enter`:

![Mac terminal search](/images/13-1-3.png)

Type in the following and press `enter`:

`pip3 install pygame`

![Mac install](/images/13-1-4.png)

This should install the pygame library on your computer.

## Your first program

Here is a simple program for checking your pygame installation works correctly:

```python
import pygame

pygame.init()
window = pygame.display.set_mode((640, 480))

window.fill((0,0,0))
pygame.display.flip()

while True:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            exit()
```

When this program is run, it should display a window:

![Pygame first window](/images/pygame_first.gif)

The program only consists of displaying a window, and it runs until the user closes the window.

## Add an image

Let's add an image to the window:

```python
import pygame

pygame.init()
window = pygame.display.set_mode((640, 480))

robot = pygame.image.load("robot.png")

window.fill((0, 0, 0))
window.blit(robot, (100, 50))
pygame.display.flip()

while True:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            exit()
```

The program uses this image of a robot, which is stored in the file `robot.png`:

![Robot](/images/robot.png)

The window should now look like this:

![Pygame with robot](/images/pygame_pic.gif)

The function `pygame.image.load` loads the image. The method `blit` draws the image at the location `(100, 50)`.

Once you have loaded an image, you can use it many times within the same window. The following code draws the image of the robot at three different locations:

```python
window.blit(robot, (0, 0))
window.blit(robot, (300, 0))
window.blit(robot, (100, 200))
```

The window should look like this as a result:

![Pygame three robots](/images/pygame_pic2.gif)

Here we set the location of the image so that it lies at the centre of the window:

```python
width = robot.get_width()
height = robot.get_height()
window.blit(robot, (320-width/2, 240-height/2))
```

The window should now look like this:

![Pygame centered robot](/images/pygame_pic3.gif)
content.CAS:
# Pygame

En estas dos últimas partes del material del curso nos familiarizaremos con la biblioteca pygame. Es una biblioteca de Python para programar juegos.

## Instalando pygame

### Linux

Abre una línea de comandos, escribe `pip3 install pygame` y presiona `enter`.

![Instalación Linux](/images/pygame_linux.png)

### Windows

Abre la terminal de Windows abriendo el menú, escribiendo `cmd` y presionando `enter`:

![Windows cmd](/images/13_1_1.png)

Escribe `pip3 install pygame` y presiona `enter`.

### Mac

Abre la _Terminal_:

![Mac spotlight](/images/13-1-2.png)

![Mac terminal search](/images/13-1-3.png)

Escribe lo siguiente y presiona `enter`:

`pip3 install pygame`

![Mac install](/images/13-1-4.png)

## Tu primer programa

Hora tienes un programa simple para comprobar que tu instalación de pygame funciona correctamente:

```python
import pygame

pygame.init()
window = pygame.display.set_mode((640, 480))

window.fill((0,0,0))
pygame.display.flip()

while True:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            exit()
```

Cuando se ejecuta este programa, debería mostrar una ventana:

![Primera ventana Pygame](/images/pygame_first.gif)

## Añadir una imagen

Vamos a añadir una imagen a la ventana:

```python
import pygame

pygame.init()
window = pygame.display.set_mode((640, 480))

robot = pygame.image.load("robot.png")

window.fill((0, 0, 0))
window.blit(robot, (100, 50))
pygame.display.flip()

while True:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            exit()
```

El programa usa esta imagen de un robot, que está almacenada en el archivo `robot.png`:

![Robot](/images/robot.png)

La ventana debería verse ahora así:

![Pygame con robot](/images/pygame_pic.gif)

Una vez que has cargado una imagen, puedes usarla muchas veces dentro de la misma ventana.

```python
window.blit(robot, (0, 0))
window.blit(robot, (300, 0))
window.blit(robot, (100, 200))
```

La ventana debería verse así como resultado:

![Pygame tres robots](/images/pygame_pic2.gif)

Aquí establecemos la ubicación de la imagen para que se encuentre en el centro de la ventana:

```python
width = robot.get_width()
height = robot.get_height()
window.blit(robot, (320-width/2, 240-height/2))
```

La ventana debería verse ahora así:

![Pygame robot centrado](/images/pygame_pic3.gif)
content.EUS:
# Pygame

Ikastaroaren azken bi zati hauetan pygame liburutegia ezagutuko dugu. Jokoak programatzeko Python liburutegia da.

## Pygame instalatzen

### Linux

Ireki komando-lerroa, idatzi `pip3 install pygame` eta sakatu `enter`.

![Linux instalazioa](/images/pygame_linux.png)

### Windows

Ireki Windows terminala menua irekiz, `cmd` idatziz eta `enter` sakatuz:

![Windows cmd](/images/13_1_1.png)

Idatzi `pip3 install pygame` eta sakatu `enter`.

### Mac

Ireki _Terminala_:

![Mac spotlight](/images/13-1-2.png)

![Mac terminal search](/images/13-1-3.png)

Idatzi hau eta sakatu `enter`:

`pip3 install pygame`

![Mac install](/images/13-1-4.png)

## Zure lehen programa

Hona hemen programa sinple bat zure pygame instalazioak ondo funtzionatzen duen egiaztatzeko:

```python
import pygame

pygame.init()
window = pygame.display.set_mode((640, 480))

window.fill((0,0,0))
pygame.display.flip()

while True:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            exit()
```

Programa hau exekutatzen denean, leiho bat erakutsi beharko luke:

![Pygame lehen leihoa](/images/pygame_first.gif)

## Irudi bat gehitzen

Gehitu dezagun irudi bat leihora:

```python
import pygame

pygame.init()
window = pygame.display.set_mode((640, 480))

robot = pygame.image.load("robot.png")

window.fill((0, 0, 0))
window.blit(robot, (100, 50))
pygame.display.flip()

while True:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            exit()
```

Programak robot baten irudi hau erabiltzen du, `robot.png` fitxategian gordeta dagoena:

![Robota](/images/robot.png)

Leihoak orain honela beharko luke:

![Pygame robotarekin](/images/pygame_pic.gif)

Irudi bat kargatu ondoren, askotan erabil dezakezu leiho berean. 

```python
window.blit(robot, (0, 0))
window.blit(robot, (300, 0))
window.blit(robot, (100, 200))
```

Leihoak honela beharko luke ondorioz:

![Pygame hiru robot](/images/pygame_pic2.gif)

Hemen irudiaren kokapena ezartzen dugu leihoaren erdian egon dadin:

```python
width = robot.get_width()
height = robot.get_height()
window.blit(robot, (320-width/2, 240-height/2))
```

Leihoak orain honela beharko luke:

![Pygame robot zentratua](/images/pygame_pic3.gif)
